Meet the Director

Ranjan Kumar

Director, Aryabhatt Boys Cottage. For room availability, food, admission details or a visit, contact details are in the Visit Us section below.

Is food really included in the rent?

Yes. The monthly rates — Single ₹12,000, Double ₹7,000, Triple ₹6,500 — include food.

Is the menu veg or non-veg?

Both. The week has veg days plus egg and chicken days. See the Food Menu section above.

Is there any deposit or admission charge?

No amount is published yet. Please call the director for current admission details.

How do I book a room?

Call or WhatsApp Ranjan Kumar on 7209633235, tell him your room type, and visit the hostel at Rajapul before confirming.
